note: Family-run park in farm country 2 miles south of Gibson City, beside the Countryside Event Center. Gravel sites 70 by 50 ft. A small swimming pond sits in the middle of the south loop. It also rents by the week and month. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: $45/night (also $250/wk, $650/mo), every site full hookup 30/50 A, open all year with water on, WiFi, laundry, call to reserve. Google 4.8/51.
